title: Dharavi bandh today to protest redevelopment project

ai.summary: Residents of Dharavi will stage a shutdown and march on Saturday to protest redevelopment project, demanding fair rehabilitation, protection of homes and livelihoods, and constitutional rights.

facts.claim: Residents of Dharavi will stage a shutdown and march on Saturday to protest redevelopment project
facts.quote: Mumbai: Residents of Dharavi, backed by leaders and activists from various political parties and social organisations, will stage a shut down of the entire area on Saturday to protest against the ongoing redevelopment process.

facts.claim: They will also participate in a march demanding transparency, fair rehabilitation and the protection of their homes, livelihoods and identity
facts.quote: They will also participate in a march demanding transparency, fair rehabilitation and the protection of their homes, livelihoods and identity, said Dharavi Bachao Andolan President Baburao Mane.

facts.claim: The redevelopment project, spread over 628.82 acres, aims to transform Dharavi through planned housing, infrastructure and commercial development
facts.quote: The redevelopment project, spread over 628.82 acres, aims to transform Dharavi through planned housing, infrastructure and commercial development.

facts.claim: Residents have accused the state government of favouring the Adani Group’s Navbharat Mega Developers Private Limited, which is executing the redevelopment project, at the expense of residents’ interests
facts.quote: The protesters have accused the state government of favouring the Adani Group’s Navbharat Mega Developers Private Limited, which is executing the redevelopment project, at the expense of residents’ interests.

facts.claim: Residents demand a minimum 500 sq ft house for slum dwellers and 750 sq ft accommodation for occupants of old municipal and approved buildings
facts.quote: The residents’ key demands include a minimum 500 sq ft house for slum dwellers and 750 sq ft accommodation for occupants of old municipal and approved buildings,

ai.background_note: Dharavi residents are protesting redevelopment project that has raised concerns over eligibility criteria, rehabilitation, relocation and future of small businesses.
